serverMetadata.instructions: speedread: fast, token-budgeted code reading. Prefer its tools over shell cat/sed/head/grep/find/ls and over one-file-at-a-time reads. Batch every file, range and symbol you need into ONE `read` call (`path`, `path:A-B`, `path#Symbol`, `#Symbol`, globs); oversized files come back as skeletons you expand by symbol instead of being cut off. `search` hits show their enclosing function/class; `trace` follows callers, callees, references and implementations; `map` orients you in a repo. After editing a file, read `path@etag` (etag from the `==>` header) to see only what changed.

data.content: Bug report: behind trusted proxies, c.ClientIP() returns the proxy's address instead of the client's. With the header `X-Forwarded-For: 20.20.20.20, 30.30.30.30` and 30.30.30.30 configured as a trusted proxy, ClientIP() should return 20.20.20.20. Find and fix the bug in the library code (do not modify tests). Verify with `go test ./...`. When done, reply with a one-line summary of the fix.

data.content: All tests pass. Fix: in `Engine.validateHeader` (gin.go), the reverse-order X-Forwarded-For scan returned as soon as it hit a *trusted* proxy IP instead of skipping past it; inverted the condition to `!engine.isTrustedProxy(ip)` so it keeps walking left through trusted proxies and returns the first untrusted (real client) IP.
